property_summary: For every call to transfer, the reference C requires that when both _tos and v are empty the call reverts (it does not accept empty recipient arrays); the mutant removed that require and will accept empty arrays and return true, so the property is that transfer(...) reverts iff _tos.length == 0 (reference: always reverts for empty _tos), which the mutant violates for some fuzzed inputs (empty arrays).
change_summary: Remove the require that _tos.length > 0, allowing transfer to accept empty _tos and return true, changing observable behavior when called with empty arrays.
